In this apartment the living room gets strong direct sun most of the day, so a Maidenhair Fern or Calathea placed in the open center would likely scorch, crisp at the leaf edges and dry out fast. They need bright but indirect light and high humidity, so filter the windows with sheer curtains, keep the plant out of the direct sun path, and add a humidity tray or humidifier. If you want a true centerpiece in that light, a sun-tolerant plant would be the safer choice.
